content.title: A Darwinian Dilemma for Realist Theories of Value
content.author: Sharon Street (Philosophical Studies 127, 2006, pp. 109–166)
content.note: The best-known evolutionary debunking argument: if natural selection shaped our moral judgements, realists cannot explain why those judgements would track independent moral truths. Street is not a theist; she draws an anti-realist conclusion. In copyright: described in our own words and cited by chapter or whole work, never quoted; no page numbers are given because no copy is held.
